instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Continual-ARC task-7ad36d70: extend a contact shape with a full stripe

For this recurring task, the grid has a uniform background, a full-height vertical marker/bar of color 2, and a compact non-background shape touching the bar on one side. The shape can differ in color, size, location, and which side of the bar it occupies.

## Transformation
1. Find the full-height vertical color-2 bar.
2. Find the adjacent compact object/segment directly touching one side of the bar. In observed demos, this was a vertical strip of color 1 to the left in one example, and a small color-7 connected shape to the right in another.
3. On the side of that shape away from the bar, identify the next column immediately beyond the shape's farthest horizontal extent. Recolor that entire column, from top to bottom, to color 8.
4. Preserve every other input cell, including the bar and the adjacent object.

Examples validated:
- 27x14: bar at column 5; adjacent color-1 strip in rows 10–18 to its left (column 4); recolor full column 3 to 8.
- 23x22: bar is row 20; despite this task being described as vertical bar in another example, this input has a full-width horizontal color-2 line at row 20 and color-7 object above it. Output adds a full-width color-8 line at row 13, preserving everything else. This demonstrates orientation: identify full-length 2-line and compact 7/1 shape touching it; draw 8-line parallel to bar, one cell beyond the object's farthest extent away from the bar.
- Fresh 10x19 test: full-height color-2 bar at column 1; color-7 shape occupies rows 6–7, columns 2–3 and touches the bar; output adds full-height color-8 stripe at column 4.

Generalized interpretation from the demonstrations: place a full-length stripe of color 8 parallel to the full-length color-2 bar, on the far side of the adjacent object, immediately beyond its extent. Preserve all other cells. Carefully check geometry: the output stripe is parallel to the 2-line and one cell beyond the object, not necessarily adjacent to the 2-line.
